rationale: Sharon's TheAgentic.Ai builds production-ready AI agent infrastructure for high-stakes industries like biotech and fintech, while Georgi is actively scaling Rilo—an AI-powered GTM automation platform using multi-agent systems to replace manual workflows for startups. Their work is complementary: Sharon's infrastructure layer and Georgi's GTM-focused agent applications represent different points on the same vertical-AI-SaaS stack, and Georgi's explicit focus on community-led distribution through hackathons and builder events aligns naturally with Sharon's infrastructure for developers.
intro_message: Sharon, meet Georgi — you're both building production AI agent systems for different verticals (infrastructure vs. GTM automation), and Georgi's hiring for execution-focused roles and running hackathons—exactly the kind of builder community that uses infrastructure like TheAgentic.Ai.
